criteria: Down 10%+ over 1 month, P/E and Forward P/E under 22, PEG under 2, net profit margin over 3%, return on equity over 5%, RSI under 45, relative volume under 1x 30-day average, market cap over $300M, excludes banks and pharmaceutical companies — top 7 by market cap
disclaimer: Informational screener only, not investment advice. Data from live market feed. Not a recommendation to buy or sell any security.

cards.name: Trade Desk
cards.why: Runs a programmatic ad-buying platform. Missed estimates by 8% on Aug 6, and shares are down 24% since — a direct reaction to the miss.

cards.name: Driven Brands
cards.why: Provides auto services through brands like Take 5 Oil Change and Meineke. Beat estimates by 12% on Aug 6, yet shares fell 13% — another beat that guidance or sector jitters overshadowed.

cards.name: Blue Bird
cards.why: Makes school buses, including electric models. Results were basically in line on Aug 5, but shares are down 12% — the move looks more sector- or guidance-driven than tied to the print.

cards.name: Navigator Holdings
cards.why: Owns and operates liquefied gas carrier ships. Beat estimates by 55% on Aug 4, yet shares are still down 11% — a big beat the market largely ignored, likely on shipping-rate or macro concerns rather than the print.

cards.name: Natural Grocers
cards.why: Runs Natural Grocers, a natural and organic grocery chain. Missed estimates by 8% on Aug 6, and shares are down 14% — a fairly direct reaction to the miss.

cards.name: Limbach
cards.why: A commercial HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractor. Missed estimates by 32% on Aug 4 — one of the sharpest misses in this group — and shares are down 35% since, largely explained by that result.

cards.name: Carriage Services
cards.why: Runs funeral homes and cemeteries. Results were roughly in line on Aug 5, yet shares are still down 15% — looks more sector-driven than tied to the earnings print itself.
